source.note: state.md The alias id context: the alias statement has a body when only units that the grammar takes before the `{` of a body lie between the alias id and a `{`; a line of only whitespace is no `newline` unit (rule 7 of the statement context reads it with its line feed), so after `state "d" as A : x` and a line of two spaces, the `{` starts the body of `A : x`, which is not divided.
